description: emailHeaders on a multipart/mixed: the block is written once, ahead of the parts, and the parts read as they do by default (only the best alternative, the attachment as before) (tikajs-5qkk).

input.text:
From: sender@example.com To: recipient@example.com Subject: Multipart Email Test Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2024 14:30:00 +0000 MIME-Version: 1.0 Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary="BOUND" --BOUND Content-Type: multipart/alternative; boundary="ALT" --ALT Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8 This is the plain text version. --ALT Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8

This is the html version.

--ALT-- --BOUND Content-Type: text/plain; name="notes.txt" Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="notes.txt" Attachment text. --BOUND--
